description: Implementation of UccServerImpl class handling server socket connections, event registration, data reception, and command parsing within the beerocks namespace.

classes.name: UccServerImpl
classes.description: Class implementing a server for UCC protocol handling socket connections, event registration, and command processing.

methods.name: UccServerImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing server socket, parser, serializer, and event loop, and registering event handlers.

methods.name: ~UccServerImpl
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up connections and event handlers.

methods.name: send_reply
methods.description: Serializes and sends a reply message through the current connection.

methods.name: add_connection
methods.description: Adds a new client connection and registers its event handlers.

methods.name: remove_connection
methods.description: Removes an existing connection and optionally its event handlers.

methods.name: handle_connect
methods.description: Handles incoming connection acceptance and sets up client event handlers.

methods.name: handle_read
methods.description: Processes incoming data, logs it, and parses commands.
